tidbit: Did you know… about 12,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Nvidia-backed Reflection launches an artificial intelligence model to compete with Chinese open models, confirmed by TradingView.
OpenAI faces an expanding regulatory nightmare, reported by The Information.
Researchers flag censorship in Alibaba's Qwen artificial intelligence model, with Hirundo finding it censors political topics and releasing modified versions to reduce bias, reported by Diya TV.
At an OpenAI forum, discussion focused on stronger teen safety measures, with a panel urging safe and age-appropriate artificial intelligence use in schools, reported by Education Week.
WIM Robotics won top 10 at an NVIDIA event, building a control layer for non-expert robot development in agriculture, reported by KoreaTechDesk.
Free every hour.
